thag7.3:1.1: Ekaputto ahaṃ āsiṃ piyo mātu piyo pitu bahūhi vatacariyāhi laddho āyācanāhi ca. || ||
thag7.3:2.1: te ca maṃ anukampāya atthakāmā hitesino ubho pitā ca mātā ca buddhassa upanāmayuṃ: || ||
thag7.3:3.1: kicchā laddho ayaṃ putto sukhumālo sukhedito, imaṃ dadāma te nātha jinassa paricārakaṃ. || ||
thag7.3:4.1: satthā ca maṃ paṭiggayha Ānandaṃ etad abravi: pabbājehi imaṃ khippaṃ, hessaty ājāniyo ayaṃ. || ||
thag7.3:5.1: pabbājetvāna maṃ satthā vihāraṃ pāvisī jino; anoggatasmiṃ suriyasmiṃ tato cittaṃ vimucci me. || ||
thag7.3:6.1: tato satthā niraṃkatvā paṭisallānavuṭṭhito ehi Bhaddā 'ti maṃ āha; sā me ās' ūpasampadā. || ||
thag7.3:7.1: jātiyā sattavassena laddhā me upasampadā; tisso vijjā anuppattā: aho dhammasudhammatā 'ti. || || Bhaddo thero.
